feishu.title: Feishu Connect
feishu.saved: Saved; the background picks it up within a second
feishu.secretQueued: Submitted; the background is writing it to secure storage
feishu.secretClearing: Submitted; the background is removing the stored secret
feishu.appIdHint: Feishu Open Platform, custom app, credentials page
feishu.secretSaved: Stored in the OS secure storage (leave empty to keep it)
feishu.secretEmpty: Not stored yet; it will be written to secure storage
feishu.setupTip: After creating a custom app on the Feishu Open Platform: enable event subscription over the long connection, subscribe to im.message.receive_v1, grant im:message, im:message.p2p_msg:readonly, im:message.group_at_msg:readonly, im:message:send_as_bot and im:resource, then publish the version. Granting im:message alone does not deliver direct messages; without im:resource text arrives but images/files cannot be downloaded.
feishu.enabledHint: When off, no long connection is opened and no message is answered
feishu.directoryHint: New conversations are created in this project
feishu.apiProfileHint: Bound to new conversations; empty follows the global profile
feishu.pushModeHint: Streaming keeps updating one card message (needs card permission); final-only sends once after the turn ends
feishu.groupMentionHint: Group messages without a mention are ignored
feishu.allowAllHint: When off, only allow-listed users are answered
feishu.followActive: Focus the conversation on the desktop
feishu.followActiveHint: Same as phone remote control: approvals can only be answered for the focused conversation
feishu.forwardApprovalsHint: Push pending tool approvals and questions of the focused conversation to Feishu
feishu.noPending: No user is waiting for approval
feishu.noAllowed: The allow list is empty; direct messages are refused and listed here
feishu.directTip: Direct messages missing? Granting only im:message does not push p2p events; add im:message.p2p_msg:readonly in the permission settings (groups need im:message.group_at_msg:readonly).
feishu.noBindings: No binding yet; send a message in Feishu to create one
